meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划分派给多个子代理并行执行,并留下可查的执行记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果已写好多步实施计划,想让代理按计划逐项落地并留痕。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan through parallel subagents and keep a traceable execution log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a multi-step plan and want agents to execute it with evidence.

howto.what: 它会按 .omo/plans 里的工作计划逐条执行复选框任务;自己不写代码,把实现、测试、审查派给并行子代理,并维护 .omo/ 的 Boulder 状态、证据账本和每个阶段独立的工作树。
howto.when: 当你说出「ulw-execute」「start work」等指令,或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的某个计划时触发。没有可选计划时会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划。

say.note: 会选取计划并开始逐条执行

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 里的计划,加上 --make-pr
say.note: 每个阶段的工作树各自推送成 PR
PR 合并后清理工作树并同步 .omo/ 状态

howto.what_en: It runs the work plan under .omo/plans checkbox by checkbox. It does not write code itself: implementation, tests and review are delegated to parallel subagents, while Boulder state, an evidence ledger and a per-phase worktree are kept.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-execute" or "start work", or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans. With no selectable plan it first invokes ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Picks a plan and starts executing it
Each phase's worktree becomes its own PR
Merges the PR, removes the worktree, syncs .omo/ state
